title: B.Sc / M.Sc Microbiology | KSS KPGU
content: f Microbiology at Krishna School of Science, Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University, Vadodara. Since its inception in 2020, the department has focused on quality education and practical training for students from rural and urban backgrounds. Our academic direction is to build skilled microbiology professionals for pharmaceuticals, food, healthcare, agriculture, and research sectors. Faculty expertise, modern laboratories, and project-based learning support this goal.
